sources.summary: National English-language press (14 April 2025): profile of Sara Millerey, a 32-year-old trans woman from Bello (near Medellín, Antioquia) who was brutally assaulted in a viral video and died from her injuries; her mother's remembrance and friends' recollections. An Antioquia case carried as national context; no Caldas-specific finding.

International broadcaster (6 August 2025): wave of anti-LGBTQ attacks in Colombia covered through the Millerey case and attacks on same-sex couples, framing a rising national pattern of violence. National context; no Caldas-specific finding.

International daily (30 July 2024) investigation "We are killed for what we are": trans women in Caquetá targeted in social cleansing by armed groups - Tatiana Cespedes forced to move twice after death threats, fears recognition by armed-group members; documents gender-identity-driven displacement where armed actors control territory. Caquetá case carried as national-frame context; no Caldas-specific finding.
